name: vesselfinder_vessel
description: Where is ship <imo/mmsi> — live AIS position, destination, ETA, and particulars. Returns the latest reported position (lat/lon, course, speed, heading, nav status), voyage info (destination, ETA, draught), and vessel particulars (type, flag, gross tonnage, deadweight). Provide either an IMO or an MMSI number. Example: vesselfinder_vessel({ imo: "9074729", _apiKey: "your-key" })

imo.description: IMO number of the vessel, e.g. "9074729". Provide imo or mmsi.

mmsi.description: MMSI number of the vessel, e.g. "477553000". Provide imo or mmsi.

_apiKey.description: VesselFinder API key (prepaid credits — get one at vesselfinder.com)
